description: This PHP class defines a specialized display field for reporting purposes within the OrangeHRM system. It extends functionality to include aggregation (e.g., MAX) over date fields in reports, allowing for customized display and data retrieval logic for date-related report fields.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregate
classes.description: A PHP class extending 'GenericDateDisplayField' that adds support for aggregate functions (like MAX) on date fields for reporting purposes, with mappings for specific date fields used in the HRM reports.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets entity alias, field, and aggregate based on the display field's alias using a predefined mapping.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object used for this display field.

methods.name: getAggregate
methods.description: Returns the current aggregate function (e.g., MAX) configured for this field.

methods.name: setAggregate
methods.description: Sets the aggregate function to be used for this display field.

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Generates and returns the SQL select clause part, incorporating the aggregate function and DTO class.
